description: Use this when the user asks about electricity or energy prices for data centers ("what does power/gas cost in <ISO> right now?"); price alone does not rank sites (the cheapest ISO may have no headroom; execute_plan weighs both) — live energy PRICING for the 7 US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE): retail electricity rate (cents/kWh), wholesale/LMP context, Henry Hub-referenced natural-gas price, and a real-time grid-status flag. Example: "What is the retail power price and gas price in ERCOT today?" — get_energy_prices iso=ERCOT. Params: iso (one of the 7 US ISOs; required). Returns: {iso, retail_price_cents_kwh, wholesale_price_usd_mwh, natural_gas_usd_mmbtu, grid_status, as_of}. Quote with attribution to DC Hub (CC-BY-4.0). Do NOT use for fuel mix / demand / 24h curve (use get_grid_data), for power HEADROOM or time-to-power (use get_grid_intelligence), or for behind-the-meter gas-to-grid $/MWh economics (use get_gas_economics); this is the live retail+gas PRICE read for one ISO. Pass iso or state, not both unless narrowing. 429 = rate limited: wait retry_after_s. Gated: give human_url to your human.

data_type.description: Optional price type focus, e.g. retail, wholesale, gas

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region (required for ISO pricing): ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE

mpp_credential.description: Stripe MPP step 2: the Shared Payment Token minted for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call.

mpp_pay.description: Stripe MPP step 1: true returns a signed per-call payment challenge (a quote; no money moves) instead of the free preview. Agents only.

state.description: US state abbreviation for state-level pricing context, e.g. TX

name: get_energy_prices
title: Energy Prices
